# orca group

Every `orca group` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca group list`

every group: id, state, revision, goal

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).

## `orca group show <group>`

one group's full view

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group import [<plan>] [--group <group>] [--estimator-profile <estimator-profile>] [--estimate-mode <estimate-mode>] [--library <library>] [--version <version>]`

import a registered plan, or a plan library version (--library), as a new draft group

- What it does: sends control verb `import-plan`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<plan>` (optional): a plan id (or unique prefix) from orca project show / config; not with --library
- `--group <group>`: the new group's id
- `--estimator-profile <estimator-profile>`: estimate with this profile
- `--estimate-mode <estimate-mode>`: strict|soft
- `--library <library>`: a plan library entry (orca plan list) instead of a registered plan
- `--version <version>`: with --library: the version's sha256; default: the entry's newest

```
orca group import plan-a
orca group import --library pl-0123456789abcdef
```

## `orca group estimate <group> [--estimator-profile <estimator-profile>] [--mode <mode>]`

ask the estimator for budgets at the current proposal version

- What it does: sends control verb `estimate`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--estimator-profile <estimator-profile>`: default: the panel's estimator
- `--mode <mode>`: strict|soft; default: the panel's

## `orca group confirm <group> [--hold] [--budget-mode <budget-mode>] [--worker-profile <worker-profile>] [--handoff-profile <handoff-profile>] [--goal-review-profile <goal-review-profile>] [--handoff-at-context-tokens <handoff-at-context-tokens>]`

confirm the task plan as shown now; it starts when a slot is free unless --hold

- What it does: sends control verb `confirm`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--hold`: confirm only; start it later with orca group start
- `--budget-mode <budget-mode>`: strict|soft when the proposal has none
- `--worker-profile <worker-profile>`: bind the worker profile
- `--handoff-profile <handoff-profile>`: bind the handoff profile
- `--goal-review-profile <goal-review-profile>`: bind the goal-review profile
- `--handoff-at-context-tokens <n>`: hand off at this many context tokens

## `orca group start <group>`

start a confirmed group (one confirmed with --hold)

- What it does: sends control verb `start`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group pause <group>`

stop dispatching new runs (running ones finish)

- What it does: sends control verb `pause-dispatch`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group resume <group>`

dispatch again after a pause

- What it does: sends control verb `resume-dispatch`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group stop-handoff <group> [--deadline <deadline>]`

stop: running tasks hand off and stop

- What it does: sends control verb `handoff-stop`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--deadline <deadline>`: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ

## `orca group resume-handoff <group> [--continue <continue>]`

resume after a completed handoff; --continue <task> continues that task from its checkpoint

- What it does: sends control verb `resume-from-handoff`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--continue <continue>` (repeatable): a task to continue (repeatable)

## `orca group archive <group>`

archive a group: records stay, it refuses every command but unarchive

- What it does: sends control verb `archive-group`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group unarchive <group>`

unarchive a group

- What it does: sends control verb `unarchive-group`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group set-limit <group> --limit <limit>`

set the group's budget limit

- What it does: sends control verb `set-limit`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--limit <limit>` (required): JSON {tokens,activeMs,attempts,sessions}

## `orca group set-integration <group> --delivery <delivery> [--trigger <trigger>] [--method <method>] [--target <target>] [--remote <remote>]`

where this group's finished work goes

- What it does: sends control verb `set-group-integration`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--delivery <delivery>` (required): keep|local|push-target|push-branch|github-pr (anything but keep needs a person token)
- `--trigger <trigger>`: task|group
- `--method <method>`: merge|squash
- `--target <target>`: the target branch
- `--remote <remote>`: the remote

## `orca group retry-integration <group>`

a blocked or conflicted integration back to idle

- What it does: sends control verb `retry-integration`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group resolve-integration <group>`

approve an agent resolving the group's integration conflict

- What it does: sends control verb `resolve-integration-conflict`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca group folder-change <group> [--take-folder] [--recheck] [--withhold]`

answer a folder change that stopped placement: --take-folder, --recheck or --withhold

- What it does: sends control verb `resolve-folder-change`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--take-folder`: keep the folder's changes and continue
- `--recheck`: look at the folder again
- `--withhold`: leave these paths out of the folder and place the rest

## `orca group depend <group> --on <on>`

make the group wait until --on <group> has landed

- What it does: sends control verb `add-group-dependency`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--on <on>` (required): the group that must land first

## `orca group undepend <group> --on <on>`

remove that wait

- What it does: sends control verb `remove-group-dependency`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--on <on>` (required): the group that must land first
